original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳Bosome Freho选区议员称Baffour Awuah愿全面配合EOCO调查
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳Bosome Freho选区议员Nana Asafo-Adjei Ayeh表示，其同僚Manhyia South选区议员Nana Agyei Baffour Awuah已准备全面配合经济与有组织犯罪办公室（EOCO）的调查，并称其无可隐瞒。相关报道还提及Baffour Awuah被正式指控洗钱及造成公共资金损失，以及其律师事务所遭EOCO搜查等说法。目前信息为单一来源。

key_facts.fact: Bosome Freho选区议员称Baffour Awuah愿全面配合EOCO调查
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Member of Parliament for Bosome Freho, Nana Asafo-Adjei Ayeh, says his colleague, Manhyia South MP Nana Agyei Baffour Awuah, is prepared to cooperate fully with the Economic and Organised Crime Office (EOCO) and has nothing to hide.

key_facts.fact: 报道称Baffour Awuah被正式指控洗钱及造成公共资金损失
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Baffour Awuah formally charged with money laundering, loss of public funds – Lawyer

key_facts.fact: 报道称Baffour Awuah将在EOCO羁押中过夜
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Baffour Awuah to spend night in EOCO custody – Atta Akyea

key_facts.fact: 报道称EOCO搜查Baffour Awuah的律师事务所引发保密担忧
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: EOCO search of Baffour Awuah’s law firm raises confidentiality concerns – Atta Akyea

uncertainties: Baffour Awuah被指控洗钱及造成公共资金损失的说法尚未证实
